component.name: QuickPackage
component.summary: Package manager for pacman, Flatpak, cargo and AUR

description.p: QuickPackage manages system packages and developer toolchains from one window.

ul.li: pacman, AUR (paru/yay), Flatpak and cargo backends
Optional mise, rustup and fvm toolchains, separated from system packages
HTTP/SOCKS5 proxy support, light/dark themes and English/Chinese UI
